result.topic_en: Euler gives a second ('alia') solution of the system λcc = μaa + νbb, λzz = μxx + νyy in a two-parameter form, derives two variant solutions by permuting the equations, tabulates the three, and checks them on the example 5zz = 2xx + 3yy.

Fragmenta ex Adversariis depromta. 207
Cum autem sit $ rac{z}{c}(bp-\mu aq)=\mu qx+py=\mu\mu
u aq^3-\mu

$=\mu aq(\mu

hinc $ rac{z}{c}=-(\mu

u qq+pp)$.
Alia Solutio. Quia semper $f$, $g$, $h$ invenire licet, ut sit $hh=ff+\mu
u gg$, per hanc aequationem multiplicetur cognita $\lambda cc=\mu aa+
u bb$ eritque
$\lambda cchh=\mu aaff+\mu
u
u bbgg+
u bbff+\mu\mu
u aagg=\mu(af+
u bg)^2+
u(bf-\mu ag)^2$.
Cum igitur esse debeat $\lambda zz=\mu xx+
u yy$, capi poterit $z=ch$ deinde $x=af+
u bg$ et $y=bf-\mu ag$, at vero ut fiat $hh=ff+\mu
u gg$, debet esse
$f=\mu
u qq-pp$ et $g=2pq$, eritque $h=\mu
u qq+pp$,
consequenter formula proposita ita resolvetur
$x=a(\mu
u qq-pp)+2
u bpq$ et $y=b(\mu
u qq-pp)-2\mu apq$ et $z=c(\mu
u qq+pp)$.
Corollarium. Haec solutio duobus modis variari potest, prouti aequationes propositae aliter disponuntur, scil. primo $\mu xx=\lambda zz-
u yy$ et $\mu aa=\lambda cc-
u bb$. Ad quem casum solutio praecedens revocabitur
si loco $\lambda,\ \mu,\ 
u,\ z,\ x,\ y,\ c,\ a,\ b$
ponatur $\mu,\ \lambda,\ -
u,\ x,\ z,\ y,\ a,\ c,\ b$.
Unde si loco $p$ et $q$ scribamus $r$ et $s$ obtinebimus
$z=c(-\lambda
u ss-rr)-2
u brs$, $y=b(-\lambda
u ss-rr)-2\lambda crs$, $x=a(-\lambda
u ss+rr)$.
Eodem modo si formulae datae ita disponantur $
u yy=\lambda zz-\mu xx$ et $
u bb=\lambda cc-\mu aa$, unde
si loco $\lambda,\ \mu,\ 
u,\ z,\ x,\ y,\ c,\ a,\ b$
ponatur $
u,\ \lambda,\ -\mu,\ y,\ z,\ x,\ b,\ c,\ a$
tum loco $p$ et $q$, $t$ et $u$, obtinebitur
$z=c(-\lambda\mu uu-tt)-2\mu atu$, $x=a(-\lambda\mu uu-tt)-2\lambda ctu$, $y=b(-\lambda\mu uu+tt)$.
Has igitur tres solutiones ita aspectui opponamus:
Solutiones x y z
I $a(\mu
u qq-pp)+2
u bpq$, $b(\mu
u qq-pp)-2\mu apq$, $c(\mu
u qq+pp)$
II $a(rr-\lambda
u ss)$ $b(rr+\lambda
u ss)+2\lambda crs$, $c(rr+\lambda
u ss)+2
u brs$
III $a(tt+\lambda\mu uu)+2\lambda ctu$, $b(tt-\lambda\mu uu)$, $c(tt+\lambda\mu uu)+2\mu atu$
I $6qq-pp+6pq$, $6qq-pp-4pq$, $6qq+pp$
II $rr-15ss$, $rr+15ss+10rs$, $rr+15ss+6rs$
III $tt+10uu+10tu$, $tt-10uu$, $tt+10uu+4tu$.
Ubi notatu dignum, quod ternae formulae in qualibet columna eosdem numeros praebere queant, dummodo fuerit $\lambda cc=\mu aa+
u bb$.
Exemplum. Sit proposita haec formula $5zz=2xx+3yy$, ut sit $\lambda=5$, $\mu=2$ et $
u=3$, tum vero quia $5.1^2=2.1^2+3.1^2$, erit $c=1$, $a=1$ et $b=1$, unde ternae nostrae solutiones in tabella hic supra apponamus. Hinc si $p=1$ et $q=1$, erit $x=11$, $y=1$ et $z=7$; si $p=1$ et $q=-1$, erit $x=\pm1$, $y=9$ et $z=7$, qui valores satisfaciunt. Sit porro pro secunda solutione $r=1$ et $s=1$ eritque $x=\pm14$ seu $\pm7$, $y=26$ seu 13 et $z=22$ seu 11. Unde fit $5zz=2xx+3yy$ sive $605=98+507$. Sit $r=1$ et $s=-1$, ut sit $x=14$ seu 7, $y=6$ seu 3 et $z=10$ seu 5. Pro tertia sit $t=1$ et $u=1$ et erit $x=21$ seu 7, $y=\pm9$ seu 3 et $z=15$ seu 5. Sit $t=1$ et $u=-1$ fietque $x=1$, $y=\pm9$ et $z=7$.
A. m. T. I. p. 299. 300.
